'''Alyssa''' (Japanese: '''イズナ''' ''Izuna'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG038|A Different Kind of Misty!]]''. She lives in [[Misty Village]] with her younger brother [[Thatcher]] and their grandfather.

She and Thatcher have the duty of protecting the light stone, which was given to their village by a "legendary hero" with a {{p|Pikachu}} many years ago to operate the Mountain Lighthouse. She uses her {{p|Magnemite}} to charge the light stone, allowing passing travelers to make their way safely through the heavy fog.

During the episode, she mistook {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} as the thieves that stole the light stone, when it was actually {{TRT}}, but later apologized for her mistake. She was also grateful to Ash for recovering the light stone from the Rocket trio, and also for teaching her brother how to believe in his {{p|Plusle}} and {{p|Minun}}.

Although Thatcher reappeared in person in ''[[AG052|Cheer Pressure]]'', Alyssa has only reappeared in a flashback.
